cues.en: So let me explain once again very quickly why the order is swapped here.
cues.zh: 再快速解釋一次，為什麼這裡順序要交換。

cues.en: So the order is swapped here because I want the number from the Matrix to be plotted in the correct row and column.
cues.zh: 交換順序，是因為希望矩陣裡的數字，畫在正確的列、欄位置。

cues.en: So when you're storing information in a matrix, you always store it using row first and then column.
cues.zh: 用矩陣儲存資訊時，一律先列、後欄。

cues.en: However, when you're making a plot, the X axis corresponds to the columns and the Y axis corresponds to the rows.
cues.zh: 但畫圖時，x 軸對應欄，y 軸對應列。

cues.en: And that's why the order is different here.
cues.zh: 這就是這裡順序不同的原因。

cues.en: It goes from white to purple, so large positive values will be deep purple and large negative values will be white.
cues.zh: 從白色到紫色，大的正值呈深紫色，大的負值呈白色。
